attorneys: J. Howard Edmondson pro se and Norman E. Reynolds on the Governor’s motion. Theodore Sachs on the motion for August Scholle.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 364 U. S. 898.) The motions of J. Howard Edmondson, Governor of Oklahoma, and August Scholle for leave to file briefs, as amici curiae, are granted. The motion of J. P. Harris et al. for leave to file brief, as amici curiae, is denied.
